india_context.procedural_notes: CERT-In cybersecurity directions (2022) mandate that system logs must be securely maintained within Indian jurisdiction for rolling period of 180 days.
india_context.transitional_notes: Cross-border data transfer must comply with Central Government negative list notifications under Section 16 of DPDP Act 2023.
verification_requirements: Verify data localization provisions for sensitive financial/health data (RBI/IRDAI directives).
